description: Asks how the SQL expression parser reads numeric literal spellings: VBA type-suffix characters (# ! @ & %), D and E exponents with and without sign, a bare or dangling exponent, a digit group separator, hexadecimal and octal forms with and without suffix and past the 16-, 32- and 64-bit widths, a 0x prefix, leading zeros, signs and repeated signs, values at the Double, Decimal, Currency and 64-bit edges, and 30-digit and 40-digit literals. Each literal is its own snapshot SELECT expr, VarType(expr), TypeName(expr) FROM One. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
